newsitem.title: ITALY: BCI APPOINTS FAUSTI AS NEW CHAIRMAN.
newsitem.headline: BCI APPOINTS FAUSTI AS NEW CHAIRMAN.

text.p: Italian banking group Banca Commerciale Italiana (BCI) on Monday appointed Luigi Fausti as its new chairman and Generali managing director Gianfranco Gutty as its new vice-chairman.

At the group's shareholders meeting there were no nominations for managing director, the joint position held by Fausti (who was also vice-chairman) and also Enrico Beneduce who died earlier this month.

The meeting confirmed BCI's executive committee as Fausti, Gutty, Michel Francois-Poncet and Alex Freiherr Von Ruedorffer with the entry of Giancarlo Cerutti. Two director generals Alberto Abelli and Pier Francesco Saviotti were announced.
